SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   B. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

   D. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.

   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

5. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs

   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   B. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.

9. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.

   D. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   C. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

12. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

14. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

16. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS

17. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
